text:
Use type hints for functions that interact with external code (libraries, APIs, teammates). Skip them for internal utility functions or single-file scripts.

Benefits:
- Better IDE autocomplete
- Easier to spot bugs early
- Self-documenting code

When to skip:
- Prototypes / throwaway scripts
- Simple one-off functions
- Performance-critical hot paths (negligible overhead)

Current Python guidance: Use them when they add clarity without clutter.
